tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Every product on sale — cottages, kayaks and canoes, parking, moorage, fishing charters — with its id, business, what it holds, how many there are, and its published price. Start here: every other tool takes a product id from this list. A cottage's price depends on the dates (price_cottages).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything published about one product: description, what is included, amenities, rules, check-in and check-out, rate table, deposit, photographs and its page on the site.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Day by day, whether a product is open between two dates, and how many are left where it is counted (boats, parking, charters; for moorage, feet free and the longest boat that fits). For a yes or no on exact dates and a number of units, quote_trip is the shorter road.

tools.name: price_cottages
tools.description: Every cottage's price for a stay, whether it is free, and whether it sleeps the party. The figures are before the cleaning fee and taxes: quote_trip gives the all-in total.

tools.name: quote_trip
tools.description: The whole basket, the way checkout charges it. Each line: its price and whether it is free for those dates in that number. tools.description: Builds the one link that puts the chosen lines in the guest's cart on experiencebamfield.com, and checks it: the lines it opens with, any that would be left out and why, and the totals. tools.name: camping_permits
tools.description: Where a camping permit is needed (the Deer Group and the Broken Group Islands), who issues it, what it costs, the longest stay, how long it takes, the campsites that can be applied for, and where the guest applies. The permit is not a line in the cart.

tools.name: list_photos
tools.description: Photographs of a business and its products, each with a description and an address that can be shown to the guest.
